caption: Task Instructions
text:
In this task, you will be asked to select a value to indicate the truthfulness level of four claims.

We will show you the text of 4 claims. For each claim, we ask you to tell us its "truthfulness level", that is, how much the claim represents the reality; how reliable it is. The truth level must be selected among 2 different labels. If the claim totally represents reality you should select "True", while if it is false you should select "False".

Note that there are some checks throughout the task, and if you do not perform these correctly you will not be able to terminate and get paid. The data from this task is being gathered for research purposes. No personally-identifying information is recorded. Participation is entirely voluntary, and you are free to discontinue at any point.
